headline: Cardinals CB Will Johnson (neck) could miss rest of season
summary: Cardinals starting cornerback Will Johnson could miss the rest of the regular season after suffering a neck injury against the Seahawks on Sunday.

headline: Sources: Eagles reuniting with Ertz as Goedert has MCL sprain
summary: The Eagles are signing tight end Zach Ertz to their practice squad after the injury to starter Dallas Goedert and other injuries at the position.

headline: Saints LT Kelvin Banks to have ankle surgery, out indefinitely
summary: Saints left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. is out indefinitely with a high ankle sprain and needs surgery, coach Kellen Moore said Monday.

headline: Chargers placing TEs David Njoku, Charlie Kolar on IR
summary: The Chargers are placing tight ends David Njoku and Charlie Kolar on injured reserve, coach Jim Harbaugh announced Monday.
